verses.11:99: وَأُتۡبِعُواْ فِي هَٰذِهِۦ لَعۡنَةࣰ وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ بِئۡسَ ٱلرِّفۡدُ ٱلۡمَرۡفُودُ

meaning: The root "rfd" primarily means a gift or gratuity, often given as aid or assistance. It also refers to a large drinking cup or bowl, especially one used for guests.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic root occurring exactly twice.
